adapters.release: Planck 2018 legacy likelihood baseline; PR4 maps tracked separately
adapters.authority: European Space Agency and Planck Collaboration
adapters.citation: Planck Collaboration, Astronomy and Astrophysics 641, A6 (2020)
adapters.license_or_terms: official archive terms and citation guidance require review before download
adapters.baseline: six-parameter Lambda-CDM with official legacy likelihood products
adapters.nuisance_plan: freeze official nuisance treatment before extension fitting
adapters.exclusion_plan: retain published baseline failures and excluded regions
adapters.checksum_plan: record official product identifiers and cryptographic hashes after authorized download
adapters.rejection_condition: published baseline cannot be reproduced before extension fitting

adapters.exclusion_plan: retain incompatible BAO regions and negative results
adapters.checksum_plan: hash each authorized support product before analysis
adapters.rejection_condition: adapter fails to reproduce released BAO baseline

adapters.release: public DR1 spectra and clustering-ready catalogs

adapters.baseline: luminal tensor propagation within the reported multimessenger bound
adapters.exclusion_plan: exclude coefficients violating the published propagation bound
adapters.checksum_plan: hash any released event products used later

adapters.citation: F. Takahashi et al., Int. J. Mod. Phys. A 41, 2630011 (2026)
